question: Who among the following was selected for the inaugural Chhattisgarh Veerni Award in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dutee Chand.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dutee Chand** was selected for the inaugural **Chhattisgarh Veerni Award in April 2021.** 
 
• The award, which recognizes the contribution of Indian women in different fields, including sports, was given virtually on April 14, 2021.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to win a gold medal at the **World University Games** held in Italy in 2019.
 
• She is a **silver-medalist** in 100 and 200 meters at the **2018 Jakarta Asian Games**.
 
• Dutee holds the national record of **11.22 secs** in 100m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Description**
 
 

 Teejan Bai
 Teejan Bai, a** Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan** awardee, is an exponent of **Pandavani**, a traditional performing art form. She was from Chhattisgarh.
 
 

 Kishore Sahu
 Kishore Sahu (22 November 1915 – 22 August 1980) was an **Indian actor**, film director, screenwriter, and producer. He was also from Chhattisgarh.
 
 

 Trimbak Sharma
 Triambak Sharma is an Indian cartoonist from Chhattisgarh.
